test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'on'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given blank needs a preposition to refer to whom the shame lies.
 
• The correct preposition in such a case is on which is used in the fixed phrase *shame on you.*
 
• Hence, option 1 or on is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.

Correct passage__ - *Once, a man and his son were going into town. (1) __they__ wanted to sell some potatoes. They went with (2) __their__ donkey, and the donkey (3) __carried__ the potatoes. While they walked, (4)__ a__ man came past on a horse.*

*"Shame (5) __on__ you!" he said. "Why do you have a donkey, but you don't ride it?"*
